status: fresh-key confirmation of a diagnostic pattern; not a production or official-decoder confirmation
purpose: Check whether the P1/P2 post-step interaction survives a new key and error stream. The original factor experiments used G0 keys 54..99; this confirmation uses group CF, which has not been used in any earlier analysis, at the same two work points.
keys: fresh group CF, keys 54..99 (46 keys), 2000 errors each, SEED=20260901; no overlap with G0 keys used in the original factor experiment
factor_mode_semantics: identical to the P1/P2 factor protocols: classic carrier, 20 main rounds, no blocked-stop, post-step after round one only, later rounds plain, post-step scans recorded separately

estimand.primary: interaction Delta = (p(post_p2) - p(post_0)) - (p(plain_p2) - p(plain_0)), averaged over keys on the risk-difference scale; 95% key-clustered percentile bootstrap, B=10000, seed=20260905
estimand.secondary: per-cell DFR and RR versus the within-policy baseline
estimand.zero_events: rule-of-three upper bound 3/N, with the binomial-trial assumption stated

gates.classic_library: factor-mode plain_0 and plain_p2 must reproduce build_decoder(c0/c2) per-instance on a 3-key x 200-error sample at each point
gates.bgf_port: the bgf-compatible replica must reproduce bgf_vasseur per-instance on a 3-key x 200-error sample at each point

decision_rule: The interaction is confirmed on fresh keys if Delta > 0 and its 95% key-cluster CI excludes 0 at the point being tested. If the CI includes 0, it is not confirmed and must be reported as such. Every cell is reported regardless of direction.
multiplicity: one prespecified primary interaction per work point; no component arms are run in this confirmation
disclosure: Fresh keys reduce key-pool artifact risk; they do not establish production DFR, official BGF behavior, or a universal law. The confirmation remains diagnostic.
